note: Designed structures — the Vision half of the map. These are what is PROPOSED for the land, never what stands on it (the county's own footprints are data/footprints.json and show only in Today mode). A structure moves through three states: 'site' is a reserved ground outline with nothing built on it, 'massing' extrudes that outline to a designed height, and 'model' places a real .glb through the three.js custom layer. Adding a building is a row here plus, for a model, a file under public/models — never a code change.
